title: EU seeks nominations for stakeholder group on tokenisation standards in finance
description: The group aims to establish a framework for monitoring compliance with the agreed standards and may formulate recommendations for EU authorities on how to incentivise compliance with those standards.

title: Statement by EU Sanctions Envoy, David O’Sullivan on the eighth Sanctions Coordinators Forum
description: The Forum’s discussions centered on priority areas to keep sustained pressure on the Kremlin’s war effort as sanctions circumvention, safeguarding the international banking sector, and crypto‑lead evasion schemes.

title: Commission seeks feedback on the functioning of EU crypto-assets rules
description: This consultations aims at gathering feedback from stakeholders and the wider public on the functioning of the EU’s regulatory framework on crypto‑assets
